parts: This is one sentence from a draft regulation.
"Applications may only be submitted through a digital app."
It sounds like progress.
But for elderly citizens, people with disabilities, and villages without a signal... it's a locked door.
Indonesia has thousands of overlapping regulations, and they don't always fit together.
Drafters cross-check them by hand, for weeks.
Generic AI chatbots invent articles that don't exist.
And the real impact only shows up after the law is signed.
Meet RuleLab.
An AI workspace for Indonesian lawmaking, built on Gemini.
Draft, verify, and test a regulation, before it reaches a single citizen.
It starts with a plain-language brief.
Gemini turns it into a draft in the official legal structure: one of fifteen regulation types, with considerations, legal basis, and numbered articles, grounded in retrieved laws.
Then, under budget pressure, a drafter tightens Article 2.
Digital only.
Saved as version two.
Now RuleLab checks every article.
Hybrid search pulls the relevant clauses from more than twelve thousand regulations, and specialist agents analyze each one.
In under a minute: three findings.
Article 2 excludes citizens without internet, colliding with the Public Service Law and the Disability Law.
Every claim links to the exact source: article, page, and document fingerprint.
If the model cites anything outside the evidence, it's rejected.
The reviewer stays in charge. One click applies the fix, as a new version.
Next, RuleLab tests the impact.
Same assumptions, two drafts.
Digital only serves seventy percent of applicants.
Draft B, with assisted channels, serves ninety-four.
That's six hundred more people, with the cost and staff workload in plain view.
Then thirty-two AI personas, from a blind citizen to a counter officer to a budget analyst, debate both drafts over five rounds.
Three hundred and twenty grounded reactions, clustered by issue, so drafters hear the concerns before they become complaints.
The result: a formatted draft and a full review report, exported to Word,
with every step logged for audit.
Around it: a legal library with a source-cited assistant,
and a regulation map across all thirty-eight provinces.
RuleLab.
Laws that fit together, and fit the people they serve.
Built by team RuleLab, with Gemini on Google Cloud.
